from hep_lfx import HepComponent, component, payload
from lfx.io import DataInput, Output
from lfx.schema import Data
class AccessResolve(HepComponent):
 inputs=[DataInput(name='value',required=True)]
 outputs=[Output(name='result',method='build')]
 async def build(self)->Data:

from hep_lfx import HepComponent, payload
from lfx.io import DataInput, Output
from lfx.schema import Data
class AccessIdentityGate(HepComponent):
 inputs=[DataInput(name='value',required=True)]
 outputs=[Output(name='go',method='route_go',group_outputs=True),Output(name='blocked',method='route_blocked',group_outputs=True)]
 def choose(self):
  selected='go' if payload(self.value).get('ready') is True else 'blocked'
  excluded=[name for name in ('go','blocked') if name!=selected]
  for name in excluded:self.stop(name)
  self.graph.exclude_branches_conditionally(self._id,excluded)
  return self.value
 async def route_go(self)->Data:return self.choose()
 async def route_blocked(self)->Data:return self.choose()

from hep_lfx import HepComponent,payload
from lfx.io import DataInput,Output
from lfx.schema import Data
class AccessItemGate(HepComponent):
 inputs=[DataInput(name='value',required=True)]
 outputs=[Output(name='source_state',method='route_source_state',group_outputs=True),Output(name='target_state',method='route_target_state',group_outputs=True),Output(name='source_alerts',method='route_source_alerts',group_outputs=True),Output(name='target_alerts',method='route_target_alerts',group_outputs=True),Output(name='path',method='route_path',group_outputs=True),Output(name='tcp',method='route_tcp',group_outputs=True)]
 def choose(self):
  ports={'source-state':'source_state','target-state':'target_state','source-alerts':'source_alerts','target-alerts':'target_alerts','path':'path','tcp':'tcp'}
  item=payload(self.value).get('item')
  if item not in ports:raise ValueError('未知冻结检查项')
  selected=ports[item]
  excluded=[name for name in ports.values() if name!=selected]
  for name in excluded:self.stop(name)
  self.graph.exclude_branches_conditionally(self._id,excluded)
  return self.value
 async def route_source_state(self)->Data:return self.choose()
 async def route_target_state(self)->Data:return self.choose()
 async def route_source_alerts(self)->Data:return self.choose()
 async def route_target_alerts(self)->Data:return self.choose()
 async def route_path(self)->Data:return self.choose()
 async def route_tcp(self)->Data:return self.choose()

from hep_lfx import HepComponent,payload
from lfx.io import DataInput,Output
from lfx.schema import Data
class AccessTcpGate(HepComponent):
 inputs=[DataInput(name='value',required=True)]
 outputs=[Output(name='OPEN',method='route_open',group_outputs=True),Output(name='REFUSED',method='route_refused',group_outputs=True),Output(name='TIMEOUT',method='route_timeout',group_outputs=True),Output(name='UNKNOWN',method='route_unknown',group_outputs=True)]
 def choose(self):
  ports=('OPEN','REFUSED','TIMEOUT','UNKNOWN')
  selected=payload(self.value).get('route','UNKNOWN')
  if selected not in ports:raise ValueError('未知TCP分支')
  excluded=[name for name in ports if name!=selected]
  for name in excluded:self.stop(name)
  self.graph.exclude_branches_conditionally(self._id,excluded)
  return self.value
 async def route_open(self)->Data:return self.choose()
 async def route_refused(self)->Data:return self.choose()
 async def route_timeout(self)->Data:return self.choose()
 async def route_unknown(self)->Data:return self.choose()
